features.name: Shared mode access to color, depth and infrared frame sources
features.description: Displays multiple frame sources (color/depth/infrared) simultaneously in shared mode. Has a 'Next Source Group' button to cycle source groups, three preview panes labelled Color/Depth/Infrared frame source, and a status/output text line.
expected_behaviour: Scenario is reachable from the navigation list with the verbatim title
Description reads 'Display multiple frame sources to screen simultaneously in shared mode access.'
A 'Next Source Group' button is present and invokable (cycles source groups)
Three labelled preview areas: Color frame source, Depth frame source, Infrared frame source
A status/output line reports source-group state (e.g. 'No source groups found.' when no camera is present)

features.name: Find and display all media frame sources
features.description: Enumerates frame sources and initializes a selected source via a frame reader. Provides three ComboBoxes (Source Group, Frame Source, Media Format) and Start/Stop buttons, plus a preview image and output text.
expected_behaviour: Scenario is reachable from the navigation list with the verbatim title
Description reads 'Enumerate frame sources, and initialize selected source using frame reader and display frames on screen.'
Three ComboBoxes present: Source Group (placeholder 'Select ...'), Frame Source (placeholder 'Select ...'), Media Format (placeholder 'Default format')
Start and Stop buttons present; Start/Stop are disabled until a source group is selected (no camera => no selectable groups => buttons remain disabled)
An output/status text area is present
